Name: Vitality Potion
Author: OceanLaboratory
Description: Unlike the energy tonic and life elixir, this vitality potion fills both health and energy bars to full. Sold at the clinic for 2000g, and is a loved gift for Harvey and a liked gift for Alex. All that's needed for this mod is Content Patcher.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and place into your mods folder.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Vitality Potion
Manifest.Description: Adds a Vitality Potion to Harvey's clinic that restores both health and energy.
Manifest.Author: OceanLaboratory
